title: Go-live trajectory tracker — Beacon Health inference rollout
content:
Purpose:
This working tracker is intended for the Customer Success + Solutions + Customer technical leads to run Beacon Health's inference rollout from kickoff through post-go-live (scale ramp). It is a living doc: update status, owners, ETAs and blockers weekly ahead of QBRs. Use the 'Status Snapshot' for execs and the milestone rows for tactical owners.

How to use:
- Update the "Status Snapshot" line each Monday before standup.
- For each milestone below, fill: Owner | Current status | ETA | Blockers (concise) | Next action owner & due date.
- Flag any renewal signals (usage, SLA acceptance, executive buy-in) in the Renewal Signals section.

Status Snapshot (summary for next QBR):
- Overall rollout phase: Canary -> Scale ramp (canary healthy, perf regressed 3% under peak, infra changes scheduled)
- Go-live target window: 2024-12-10 to 2025-01-07 (soft window)
- Risk level: Medium-High (network egress & KMS alignment are outstanding)
- Renewal trigger target: SLA sign-off + 3 weeks of sustained throughput at committed QPS

Milestones (current canonical list):
1) Project kickoff & charter sign-off | Owner: Jenna Liu (Customer TL) & Priya Shah (CS) | Status: Done | ETA: 2024-09-22 | Blockers: None | Next: N/A
2) Architecture review & security alignment (VPC/KMS) | Owner: Liam Chen (Solutions Eng) | Status: In progress | ETA: 2024-10-10 | Blockers: Customer KMS key policy gaps; compliance needs HSM enclave mapping | Mitigation: engage Security to run a policy mapping workshop (assigned Marco Rossi) | Next: Workshop scheduled 2024-10-05 (Marco)
3) Network connectivity (VPC peering / proxy rules / IP allowlist) | Owner: Daniel Park (Infrastructure) | Status: Blocked | ETA: 2024-10-18 | Blockers: Customer firewall requires static egress; DevOps cannot confirm egress IP range until Dedicated pool is provisioned | Mitigation: provide temporary NAT pool and update docs; request emergency peer from CloudOps | Next: Provision NAT pool by 2024-10-07 (Daniel)
4) Model selection & quantization profile decision | Owner: Sofia Martinez (Applied ML) | Status: Done | ETA: 2024-09-30 | Blockers: N/A | Next: Create model-ops checklist for canary
5) Integration test harness & synthetic load tests | Owner: Solutions Eng (Liam Chen) | Status: In progress | ETA: 2024-10-21 | Blockers: Missing sample production-ish prompt dataset; data team to anonymize. | Mitigation: Use surrogate prompts and later re-run once dataset available | Next: Get anonymized dataset by 2024-10-09 (Customer data ops)
6) Canary rollout (10% traffic) | Owner: Priya Shah (CS) + SRE | Status: Pending | ETA: 2024-11-01 | Blockers: Canary playbook finalization; automations for automatic rollback not fully tested | Mitigation: Manual gating until automation is qualified; extra SRE on-call during first 48h | Next: Complete canary playbook 2024-10-25 (Priya)
7) Performance validation & latency SLO verification | Owner: Site Reliability (Marco Rossi) | Status: In progress | ETA: 2024-11-05 | Blockers: Under-provisioned KV cache on Dedicated pool leading to latency tail spikes under multi-tenant sim | Mitigation: Tune cache settings and re-run targeted tail-latency tests | Next: KV cache tuning 2024-10-28 (Marco)
8) Data governance & logs export (auditing & PII controls) | Owner: Customer privacy lead (Jenna Liu) | Status: In progress | ETA: 2024-11-12 | Blockers: Legal needs retention policy language; SIEM ingest format mismatch | Mitigation: Draft retention addendum and run SIEM schema transform (CS to assist) | Next: Draft ready 2024-10-20 (Priya)
9) Ops runbook & incident playbooks handed off | Owner: Solutions Eng + SRE | Status: Draft | ETA: 2024-11-20 | Blockers: Missing runbook steps for model-fallback scenarios | Mitigation: Add explicit fallback decision tree, tie to traffic routing policy | Next: Draft update 2024-11-01 (Liam)
10) SLA acceptance testing & sign-off (customer + Redwood) | Owner: Customer Success Lead (Priya Shah) | Status: Pending | ETA: 2024-12-01 | Blockers: Network & KV cache risks need mitigation first | Mitigation: Conditional acceptance upon successful canary and 2-week stability window | Next: Schedule SLA test window 2024-11-25 (Priya)
11) Scale ramp & capacity provisioning | Owner: Platform Eng | Status: Pending | ETA: 2025-01-07 | Blockers: Dedicated capacity approval and budget commit | Mitigation: Prepare cost/throughput scenarios and exec summary for finance | Next: Capacity proposal 2024-11-15 (Platform Eng lead)
12) Post-go-live review & handoff to account team | Owner: Customer Success | Status: Pending | ETA: 2025-01-21 | Blockers: N/A | Next: Draft QBR agenda and evidence pack 2025-01-14 (Priya)

Blocker register (current high-priority):
- Firewall / static egress IP requirements (impact: prevents test harness) | Owner: Customer infra | Action: Temporary NAT pool offered by Redwood | Target resolution: 2024-10-07
- KMS policy alignment and HSM mapping (impact: cannot complete security sign-off) | Owner: Customer security / Redwood Security | Action: Policy mapping workshop + sample IAM policy | Target resolution: 2024-10-12
- Missing production-like prompts for performance tests (impact: delayed perf validation) | Owner: Customer data ops | Action: Provide anonymized subset or approve surrogate set | Target resolution: 2024-10-09

Risk & mitigation summary:
- Risk: Latency tail under multi-tenant sim -> Mitigation: KV cache tuning, dedicated cache sizes per tenant; SRE to run targeted tail tests
- Risk: Budget/commit delays push scale ramp -> Mitigation: Run cost sensitivity scenarios to propose phased ramp with auto-scaling thresholds
- Risk: Regulatory retention policy mismatch -> Mitigation: Draft addendum and involve compliance early; offer additional log-redaction pipeline

Renewal signals (to monitor):
- SLA acceptance and signed runbook addendum
- Sustained throughput at committed QPS for 3 continuous weeks post-canary
- Executive adoption (product roadmap integration) or engineering champions declaring long-term adoption
- Early overages (positive) indicating product value but require capacity talk

Decision log (brief):
- 2024-09-30: Chosen quantized model variant v1.2 for lower-cost production path (decided by Applied ML + Customer).
- 2024-10-02: Agreed interim NAT approach if peering delays persist (Decision: temporary NAT pool).

Open questions / Notes to CS lead:
- Confirm whether Beacon Health will allow Redwood-managed NAT for initial 4-week window (Jenna to confirm by 2024-10-04).
- Decide renewal checkpoint: do we require formal SLA sign-off + 3 weeks of throughput, or SLA sign-off + exec thumbs-up? Recommend the former for objective measure.

Weekly update template (copy into QBR prep):
- Week (YYYY-MM-DD):
- Overall phase (Kickoff/Canary/Scale):
- Top 3 risks this week (brief):
- Key blocker escalation(s) and owners:
- Action items completed since last update:
- Planned actions for next week with owners & due dates:

This doc is intentionally lightweight and operational. For the canonical checklist and runbooks, see linked Confluence page (confluence:INF-4079-implementation-playbook). Keep this file as the tactical, customer-facing tracker to use in weekly touchpoints and QBR prep.
